source: resources/Written Responses Rubric.pdf (Language Arts - Written Responses: Demonstrating Comprehension). Wording copied exactly.

levels.1: Demonstrates limited understanding of the text. Responses may be inaccurate or incomplete.
levels.2: Demonstrates some understanding of the text. Responses show partial comprehension.
levels.3: Demonstrates a clear understanding of the text. Responses accurately address the question.
levels.4: Demonstrates thorough understanding of the text. Responses show thoughtful insight and deeper connections.

levels.1: Provides little or no evidence from the text to support answers or opinions
levels.2: Provides limited or general evidence from the text. Connections between evidence and answers may be unclear.
levels.3: Uses relevant evidence or examples from the text to support answers, ideas, and opinions.
levels.4: Uses specific and meaningful evidence from the text and clearly explains how it supports their thinking.

levels.1: Responses are incomplete or difficult to understand. Frequently uses fragments rather than full sentences.
levels.2: Attempts to use full sentences, but errors in grammar and sentence structure sometimes affect clarity.
levels.3: Communicates ideas using complete sentences, proper grammar, and appropriate sentence structure.
levels.4: Communicates ideas clearly and effectively using varied sentence structures and consistently strong grammar.
